description: Changes the state of components in the active configuration: fixed or floating, suppressed or resolved, the configuration of its file each uses, how a subassembly solves (rigid or flexible), hidden or shown. Give at least one property; each component gets every property given. Checked: every property reads back as asked; otherwise every edit is put back.

document.description: The assembly: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

components.description: The components: each a reference (r1.component.…) or a name (bracket-1; sub-1/pin-1 inside a subassembly).

suppression.description: Suppress, or resolve (load in full, as references to its geometry need).

configuration.description: The configuration of the component's file to use.

solve_as.description: For subassemblies only: solve rigid (as one body) or flexible (its own mates move it).
